label: prop:cosimplicial-crossed-groupoid
title: Cosimplicial crossed groupoid
html:
Proposition. Cosimplicial crossed groupoid

Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be a quantum observable universe with recursive brane tower \{A_n\}_{n \geq 0} (recursive brane tower) and substrate parameter q. Equipped with the Yekutieli triples (x^{(n)}, g^{(n)}, a^{(n)}) (Yekutieli triple), the assignment

  [n]  \longmapsto  \mathfrak{G}_n

from the simplex category \Delta to the 2-category of gerbes on M extends to a cosimplicial crossed groupoid. In this cosimplicial object:

  1. The coface maps \delta^i \colon \mathfrak{G}_{n} \to \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} are given by jet prolongation acting on objects (inserting the i-th face in the Čech nerve).
  2. The codegeneracy maps \sigma^j \colon \mathfrak{G}_{n+1} \to \mathfrak{G}_{n} are given by the descent homomorphism \mathfrak{d}_{n+1} (collapsing the j-th degeneracy).
  3. The crossed structure is furnished by the conjugation action of the 1-morphisms g_{ij}^{(n)} on the 2-morphisms a_{ij}^{(n)} via the adjoint representation of \mathrm{SU}_{q_n}(2).
